_readme: Strings of the Recording Manager's menus (the Manager tab of the Training pause menu, its dialogs, the Community window, the tickers). The language follows the GAME's text language (via.Language). Missing key or language -> English. %s / %d are format slots, in order; <ICON ...> / <color ...> tags are the game's own markup. _context: where each text shows; max: the room in units (one unit about half the font size; a CJK, kana or Hangul character is 2, any other 1), checked by tools/localisation/check_locale.py; game / guid: the text is the game's own message, copied here by tools/localisation/sync_game_words.py.
